description: v2.3.0 (pre-release re-cut; replaces the earlier v2.3.0 asset that users reported against in #34 and #35). Same content as the v2.3.1 re-cut: Table Notes (vivekagarwal.playwithdb 20261111) premium unlock for PDF/Word/Excel export, publishing and the paid set, with the AdMob slots skipped (#29); Netflix (Android TV, com.netflix.ninja) clone, CertCheck, household-prompt, network-fingerprint and in-process ad-remover patch set (ported from ajstrick81/morphe-androidtv-patches, GPL-3.0); Mereframe 0.8.4 crash fix, array-length-preserving wrapper guards (#34) and per-distinct-rejection diagnostic logging for the remaining capture/develop refusal; Reddit comment TreeData discovered by constructor shape so Show deleted posts and comments applies on every 2026.42.0 build (#35); Amazon Business compatibility and the screenshot-detection patch from PR #31. Verified by building the Android bundle, applying the Table Notes and Mereframe patches to the real APKs and dumping the patched DEX; on-device runtime verification of the new app patches is still pending.
